_comment: The ribbon, judged on its own. Dim and blur are pinned to 0 for the same
reason the boil test pins them: an effect judged through another effect's
filter has cost more time here than any bug.
The style is set by `waveformStyle`, NOT by editing a preset in source.
Four 'different' style renders once came out identical because a source
replacement quietly matched nothing. A bad name here throws by name.
topic: The Swedish Vallhund, a small Nordic herding dog breed from Sweden. Everything shown must be dogs, Scandinavian farms, homes and green northern countryside. Never deserts, never cattle without a dog present.
